name: amfx-crude-equilibrium-zones-research
description: amFX reproduction (02AUG23 p3): WTI crude oil 2022-2023 with equilibrium zone reference lines at 63.50, 76.70, 83.50, 93.50. TV chart shows native candlesticks for CL-Futures. Dashboard chart shows close price with horizontal equilibrium levels. Captures Brent Donnelly's range-bound thesis: current equilibrium 63.50-83.50, new equilibrium zone 83.50-93.50 if close above $84.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: CRUDE OIL EQUILIBRIUM ZONES (02AUG23 p3)
# =============================================================================
# Brent Donnelly's range-bound crude oil thesis:
# - Current equilibrium: $63.50 - $83.50
# - New equilibrium: $83.50 - $93.50 if close above $84
# - Key level at $76.70
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='WTI Crude: Where Are We in the Equilibrium Range?',
    category='Equilibrium Zones',
    y_axis_label='Price (USD/bbl)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WTI Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=63.50, title='$63.50 Floor', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        ReferenceLine(value=76.70, title='$76.70 VWAP', color=Color.Purple, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=83.50, title='$83.50 Ceiling', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        ReferenceLine(value=93.50, title='$93.50 Upper Target', color=Color.Purple, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=close)
